steps.content: From the podium, the representative councilor from Paradeisos solemnly declares that, despite a days-long ceasefire, the Farland Alliance has ultimately chosen to resume hostilities.

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: The twenty-four-hour window has closed. It seems the Farland Alliance has chosen the path of greatest folly. They had a chance to end this. Instead, they have chosen to escalate.

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: In response, BR-003 has been activated for offensive operations. To mount a swift and decisive counteroffensive, we must consolidate the city's resources under a single, unified command. Therefore, we now bring to the floor for a vote: the DisCity Emergency Powers Act and the War Resolution Against the Farlands.

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: This resolution will authorize full military engagement and grant EDGE the clear, unambiguous authority to commandeer all city resources for the duration of this emergency. This is not merely procedural; it is the key to our victory.

steps.speaker: Councilor B
steps.content: But this draft... it deviates from the one originally proposed by Speaker Max King. Were these amendments approved by the Speaker himself?

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: Speaker King's position is always aligned with our own.
The other councilors whisper among themselves. The Speaker's absence is a profound shock at such a critical session.

Just as the chamber erupts in commotion, the doors burst open. Soldiers stream in, their strides long and determined. They shove the overwhelmed security guards aside without breaking formation, causing a collective gasp of shock and outrage.

steps.speaker: Councilor B
steps.content: What is the meaning of this?! The resolution hasn't even passed! DisCorps has no authority here. Get out!
Augustus glances at her with a contemptuous smile.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I assumed the council leading this city would be smart enough to read the situation. Apparently, I overestimated you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: The war is at our doorstep. It's time you learned who you can actually rely on to stay alive.

steps.speaker: Councilor B
steps.content: What—
With an air of unquestionable authority, Augustus strides to the front of the chamber and commandeers the central stage.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I don't have time to waste on formalities. Let's cut to the chase.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Under your "esteemed" leadership these past few years, DisCity has flourished, so thoroughly infiltrated by Mania extremists, completely exposed to Outland spies. The enemy knew every weakness before they even fired a shot.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: The FAC is pinned down in the DisSea. Our Hypercube reserves are almost gone. Even MBCC, our last bulwark against the Black Rings, has walked into an Outland trap and is now completely paralyzed.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: And now your so-called "ally" has unleashed a Tide of Ashes outside our walls. They've cut off every escape route. Let me be clear: they are not letting anyone out of this city alive.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So, all those assets you've stashed in the Outlands and all those connections—what good are any of them if you can't physically escape?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: If we lose this war, your wealth becomes their spoils. And you won't be around to miss it.

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: ...Stop with the fear-mongering. We still have Paradeisos. And <color=#fb9259>BR-003</color>.

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: Compared to <color=#fb9259>BR-005</color>, our development of BR-003 is far more advanced. Our catastrophe weapon is superior. It can protect this city from any invasion.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Hah, perfect timing! I've just received a new operational plan from EDGE. One that incorporates BR-003.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Our goal isn't to break the enemy here. It's to bleed them dry while we spend as little as possible.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: While the FAC holds the line, I will take my forces to the Outlands. We will decapitate their war leadership and bring the entire region under control.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: EDGE has done the math. They trust in my capability to get it done. As for you?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Your fortunes, your lives... to them, you're just a line item. Easily replaced with new councilors.
In the chamber, nearly half the councilors turn deathly pale.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: N-no one said the risk was this severe! Who can protect us? The FAC can't!

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Is there any way out of the city? Any way? Forget the assets. We need to get out!

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Can't we just destroy that Black Ring? MBCC... wait, what about the MBCC Chief? Isn't he the expert? Can your forces handle it?
steps.female_content: Can't we just destroy that Black Ring? MBCC... wait, what about the MBCC Chief? Isn't she the expert? Can your forces handle it?

steps.content: Their fear of war now greater than their fear of the rebel leader, they choose Augustus. The right choice.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: You said you wanted to reclaim everything you lost through war. So... if your forces can repel the enemy and protect DisCity, the council will agree to welcome you back.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: We'll give you everything. The FAC's authority, the rightful status of the DisCity military. EDGE has no right to interfere; they've failed us in this war. We will grant you absolutely everything.
Suddenly, a chorus of voices erupts. The councilors, their convictions shifting with the wind, rush to decide where to pledge their loyalties.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Is it really the case?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So this chamber is now ready to "support" me? You're prepared to pardon our past on behalf of the city-state and restore DisCorps to its rightful place, just like that?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: And what of my opposition? I know many of you still hold a grudge.

steps.speaker: Councilors
steps.content: That's all in the past! Protect this city, and you'll have our full support as DisCity's general! Absolutely! We support you! The past is behind us! We stand with you now, General Augustus!
A single hand rises.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: I... object!
A sharp voice slices through the sycophantic chorus. The irony is palpable: it issues not from any councilor, but from the unassuming recording clerk stationed at the room's periphery.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Oh. I remember you.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: The military clique back then... they were all ambitious. Brutal. They'd always believed in rule through force. After they seized power, they brought nothing but suffering to the city-state. For twelve years.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: I know exactly what you've done.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: I may not be a councilor, but I understand the council's duty. It must resist both the temptation of self-interest and the threat of violence. Its sole purpose is to serve the city-state and its citizens. This is the institution meant to safeguard fairness and justice for all.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: No matter how you justify this—even if we ignore the past—it doesn't change the fact that you're trampling on our fundamental principles.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: Just look at what you're doing right now... storming in with soldiers, aiming guns, making threats. You exploit fear to corrupt them, all to seize more power for yourself.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: This isn't about "extraordinary measures for extraordinary times"... If you seize power like this, you'll only become more dependent on violence. The next time you face a challenge, you'll reach for your guns again, threatening and coercing until we're living the same nightmare all over again!

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: Am I wrong, General Augustus?!
The answer he receives is solitary applause. Only Augustus claps for her challenger, leaving the councilors to watch with ashen faces.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: A fine speech. Do go on... Actually, let me ask—

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Who else agrees with him?
The moment her words hang in the air, a series of explosions thunder from outside, as if answering the general's challenge.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: It seems our enemy was counting on our schedule today. They've launched a precision strike on this building, hoping to decapitate our council before it can unite.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Rest easy, councilors. My troops have already secured an evacuation route. Those who have cast their votes may follow my soldiers to safety.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: DisCorps will honor your support by ensuring you live to see tomorrow. Protecting this city remains our duty as soldiers.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: However, those who just voiced their opposition... you will stay.
A smile cuts across Augustus's face as chaos erupts throughout the chamber. She may blame the enemy's artillery, but the truth is written in the flash of each explosion—this is her masterpiece.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I'd love to hear your thoughts in full. Come now, didn't you have more to say?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: ...You monster!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: How brave. It's good to see the new generation still has fire in its belly. I'll remember you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Besides this gentleman... anyone else?
